meta.note: Full cross-ISO × pathway × endpoint table. 175 rows (7 ISO × 5 pathway × 5 endpoint). Pathways: 1a (onshore VRE+storage only, Card R), 1b (+offshore wind), 2a, 2b, 3. All MANIFEST.json fields plus derived metrics per methodology.md. Stranding per Card K revised (comparative-to-P3, VRE+storage+gas only). Retirement per Card L revised (endogenous economic retirement cumulative GW). Feasibility ceilings per Card J (physical + economic).
